description: Trendata connects you to real-time market intelligence and consumer search data. It allows you to easily analyze global locations, product categories, and specific brands or retailers directly within your workflow. By providing historical search volumes and concrete growth metrics, you can accurately spot consumer preferences and changing market trends. It turns complex data into clear, actionable insights for smarter business decisions.
